title: Irena Sendler and the Names in Jars
short_teaser: Irena Sendler helped rescue Jewish children during the Holocaust and preserved their identities in hidden records.
story: Irena Sendler helped rescue Jewish children during the Holocaust and preserved their identities in hidden records. Courage can include protecting the future story of a person, not only the present life. A life story becomes useful when it helps us recognize choices, courage, persistence, and possibility in our own. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
